text:
lina.p: Starting thread for CareConnect POC triage. Need to agree MVP endpoints, success metrics, security gating items, and a 5-week timeline. Quick takes?

omar.s (CareConnect): MVP endpoints: 1) /visit-summary (single-note summarize), 2) /med-list-extract (structured meds + doses), 3) /triage-assist (patient symptom -> recommended next step). Must keep PHI encrypted.

ravi.se: For quality, propose clinician accept rate >85% for summaries, med extraction F1 >0.9, triage precision >0.8 on our sample set. Latency target p95 <350ms for single-note endpoints.

secops-liaison-bot: Security gate: signed BAA, DPA, customer-managed KMS option, network allowlist or VPC peering, SSO (SAML) for clinician accounts, and completed security questionnaire. Also need model provenance and any third-party deps.

omar.s (CareConnect): We can provide 300 synthetic notes + 50 labeled med lists. We'll need SAML for staff and IP allowlist. Is Private deployment required or can hosted with VPC peering work?

lina.p: Hosted + VPC peering should be fine for POC if legal approves DPA + BAA. Private (on-prem) reserved for later. We'll request network diagram and SAML metadata this week.

devops-bot: Note: webhook semantics support idempotency-key header and retry 30s backoff. Async job for batch med extraction available.

ravi.se: Eval plan: 100 blind summaries for clinician review, 200 med extraction examples for automated eval, and 50 scenario flows for triage. We'll also run PHI-redaction regression with entity match and regex checks.

omar.s (CareConnect): Procurement note: security questionnaire turnaround ~2 weeks. We need a faster path. Any blockers?

lina.p: Action items: 1) Omar to upload samples + SAML metadata by Tue, 2) Secops to send questionnaire and KMS options, 3) Ravi to share prompt templates and curl examples. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs.

omar.s (CareConnect): Sounds good, thanks.

secops-liaison-bot: Reminder: network review may require diagram and traffic flow; expect ~7 business days.

lina.p: Thanks team — will send invite.
